candidates.change_summary: Remove the require that prevents re-locking, so lockInGuess can be called again and overwrite an existing guess.
Remove the 1 ether payment requirement so a caller can lock in a guess without sending exactly 1 ether.
Set the guess block to the current block number instead of the next block number.
Remove the assignment of the guess hash so the stored guess is never recorded.
Remove the assignment of the guess block so the lock-in is never registered (leaving the block as zero).
Delete the statement resetting guesses[msg.sender].block to 0, so the stored block remains set after settle.
Delete the require that block.number is past the locked-in block, allowing settle at or before the target block where blockhash is 0.
Delete the require that the contract balance is at least 2 ether before paying out.
Replace the payout transfer of 2 ether with a transfer of 1 ether, changing the amount paid to winners.
Negate the win comparison from == to !=, so payouts go to non-matching guesses.
Compute the answer as the raw blockhash instead of its keccak256 hash, changing which guesses win.
Flip the guard require(guesses[msg.sender].block != 0) to == 0, so settle only proceeds for addresses with no locked-in guess.
Compute the answer from blockhash(guesses[msg.sender].block - 1) instead of the locked-in block, changing which guesses win.
